# Navigation and sidebar (autogenerated)

This site uses an autogenerated sidebar. The structure mirrors the folders/files under `website/docs`.

- Add a Markdown file anywhere under `website/docs` and it will appear in the sidebar automatically.
- Use `_category_.json` inside folders to control labels, order, collapsing, and index pages.

## `_category_.json` reference
Example in `docs/command/_category_.json`:

```json
{
  "label": "Commands",
  "position": 2,
  "collapsed": false,
  "link": { "type": "generated-index", "title": "CLI Commands" }
}
```

- `label`: Display name for the folder in the sidebar
- `position`: Ordering among sibling categories
- `collapsed`: Whether the section is collapsed by default
- `link.type`: Use `generated-index` to auto-generate a landing page or use `doc` to point to a specific page

Using a specific doc for the category index:

```json
{
  "label": "Commands",
  "position": 2,
  "link": { "type": "doc", "id": "command/getting-started" }
}
```

If a folder contains a `README.md`, Docusaurus automatically uses it as the category index.

Raw JSON you can copy:


{`{
  "label": "Commands",
  "position": 2,
  "collapsed": false,
  "link": { "type": "generated-index", "title": "CLI Commands" }
}`}

## Ordering individual pages
- Files are ordered alphabetically by default.
- To control order within a folder, use numeric prefixes (e.g. `01-`, `02-`) or set `sidebar_position` in the page front matter.

```md
---
sidebar_position: 1
sidebar_label: "Overview"
---

# Getting Started
```

- `sidebar_position`: Lower numbers appear first.
- `sidebar_label`: Overrides the sidebar title for this page.

## Tips
- Keep folder names short and semantic (e.g., `command/`, `config-management/`).
- Use `generated-index` for a quick overview page; replace it with a real doc later if needed.
- For very large sections, split into subfolders (categories) to keep navigation manageable.
